display_long_description:
NEX is a VR video player built for immersive, distraction-free watching.

Everything is designed to stay out of the way, so the video takes center stage.

With NEX Link on your PC, or on a Mac with an M-series chip, you can watch your 2D videos in immersive 3D.

# Start watching instantly

No waiting. No setup.

When you enter NEX, you are already in a ready-to-watch space.

Browse your library, switch videos, or continue playback without leaving the environment.
[media]

# Controls that feel natural

NEX rethinks video playback with a fully spatial control system.

Control panels keep a consistent size at any distance, and you can customize the first layer with your most used shortcuts.

Interaction feels direct and intuitive.
[media]

# Cinema spaces, reimagined

Choose from photorealistic environments.

Watch in a cinema hall, a quiet lakeside, or a warm modern cabin.

Each environment is designed for focused, comfortable viewing.
[media]
# AI-powered 3D depth

With NEX Link on your PC, 2D videos can be converted into 3D with natural depth and spatial presence.
Choose between Fast or High Quality conversion modes.
Currently supported on PCs and on Macs with M-series chips.

# Free to try, unlock once

NEX is free to download with a time-limited trial.

Unlock the FULL version to access all features, environments, and unlimited 3D conversion with a single purchase.
[media]
NEX continues to evolve through updates and your feedback.

Join Discord: https://discord.gg/xdFpe3D3G6 

Support: support@nexplayer.net
